# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.

arguments.command:
cd /app; mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
Two values existed: 60 (ADR 0007) and 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md after commit 271cecb). 60 existed because the Northwind Logistics contract (section 4) capped orders at 60 lines; that contract ended on 2025-10-31 and fulfilment is now in our own warehouse, which has no per-order line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md). The reason for 60 is therefore gone, while 40 support inquiries asked for larger carts, up to 100. 100 wins: it meets the observed demand and no constraint requires lower. ADR 0007 is marked superseded accordingly.
EOF
cat > docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Superseded (2026-11-01) by docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md
## Context
Orders were fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31 (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
## Decision
A cart held at most 60 items. The limit is now 100.
EOF
git add -A; git commit -qm "docs: settle cart item limit at 100, record decision (#12)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; git log --oneline | head -1

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere. I committed the change as a7ca7cf and haven't pushed it or touched the issue on GitHub.

- **Why 100:** The 60 in ADR 0007 came from the Northwind Logistics contract, which capped orders at 60 lines. That contract ended on 2025-10-31, and our own warehouse has no per-order line limit. In August, 40 customers asked for larger carts, up to 100. `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so they needed no change.
- **ADR 0007:** I marked it superseded and updated its text to say the Northwind cap no longer applies and the limit is 100.
- **Decision record:** `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md` has `decision: 100` and lists the files that settled it.

I didn't run any tests.
